metadata.description: Hyperfocussed & obsessive utilities for the discerning dev goblin

plugins.name: roadmap
plugins.description: Roadmaps as a dependency graph: JSON source of truth, mechanical status recompute, projected task lists, Mermaid diagrams, an HTML dashboard, the interview, review and next-task skills that drive it, and /ready, a pane that shows the ready set and claims a task.

plugins.name: goblin-jester
plugins.description: hElLo. i aM tHe JeStEr. i WaTcH, i hEcKlE, i hOlD tHiNgS. i ToUcH nOtHiNg. A mod: goblin-mode's face inside Claude Code. A goblin in the band that reacts to the session, hint lines in its voice, a mask over every question, frames by model tier, a day cycle and the project theme's colours. Terminal only.

plugins.name: goblin-seneschal
plugins.description: Your grievance has been noted, my liege, and filed with the others. The underlings are mustered and the chambers stand inspected. Two mods: /log-grievance logs a grievance with Claude Code itself without a turn, context pre-filled; /muster-underlings shows every underling (Claude Code session) on the machine and sends one a line. Six skills: overhear-grievance, proclaim-releases, proclaim-changes, inspect-chambers, audit-prose and consult-dossiers.

plugins.name: mission-control
plugins.description: Coordinate several Claude Code sessions on one repository: a ledger of shared-resource slots enforced by hooks, a /mc board pane, tools that report, request, grant and broadcast, a kick-off that writes each session's brief, and the protocol that came out of running it.
